verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships an official MCP server that lets an agent ask about sync status ("was my last postgres sync successful", "are any of my connections broken"). A write scope can be enabled, and the REST API manages the account programmatically. However, no evidence explicitly shows re-triggering a sync or retrieving failure details to diagnose a run. Missing for 10: explicit documented sync-trigger/re-run endpoint or MCP tool, documented failure-diagnosis detail (error logs, root cause) via API/MCP, independent hands-on corroboration of the agent workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can check sync status, diagnose a failed run, and re-trigger it through an API or MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://github.com/fivetran/fivetran-mcp
It allows you to ask read-only questions like "when was the last time my postgres connection completed a sync?" and "are any of my connections broken?"
Set `FIVETRAN_SCOPE` to `read/write` or `read/write/delete` to unlock write and delete operations
Set up and scale your data pipeline, and manage your Fivetran account programmatically using the Fivetran REST API.
